capabilities: Open links, middle-clicks and new-tab commands in the current tab instead of a new one
Close any extra tabs created by workspaces, drag-and-drop or other plugins
Hide the tab bar in the main editor area and in popout windows
Keep sidebar tabs, splits and popout windows working with one note each
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; manual installation or BRAT is required. Untested on mobile. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0+.
motivation: The README explains the author chose a plugin over a theme because hiding the tab bar with CSS alone would leave hidden tabs being created with no way to see or switch to them.
problem: Obsidian's tabbed workspace lets links, commands and plugins open notes in new tabs, which some users want replaced by a single-tab workflow.

relations.evidence: You can also install it with BRAT using the repository kuberrr0/obsidian-remove-tabs.

summary: Tab-removal plugin that hides the tab bar and makes every new tab request reuse the current tab, so only one tab ever exists.
